events.text_en: A timber magistrate's son of Tùng Gian Thành fails the pines' chant and leaves to guard caravans on the pine-sea roads.
On the third night of the wolf winter a caravan guard named Hứa Vãn Cung shoots the grey wolf that leads the pack on the Tùng Hạ road, and the wolves go back into the pines.
